text_block_list.text: As I passed by the gymnasium――

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Kgh, and I was so close
to matching Ryan's record too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hm? The person standing over there...
You're an academy Trainer, right!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes, special free throw training!
――To defeat Mejiro Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ryan sank way more consecutive free throws than I did.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This is...!
――The 39th rival that I gotta take down!
choice_data_list: Aren't there way too many rivals?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh, ya think so?
Feels pretty normal to me, though...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oguri-senpai, my race rival; Bakushin O, my class rep rival; and Biko, my rival in protecting the academy's peace...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And then there's like, rivals like Fukukitaru,
who always pull the winning popsicle stick first!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I was supposed to have a lucky stick quick-draw contest with Fukukitaru today!
I almost completely forgot, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, that's my cue to bounce!
Catch ya laterrr!!
Bamboo Memory hastily cleaned up the balls and sprinted away toward the exit.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: True that. As long as I'm in it, I wanna win!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Just challenging them and winning
ain't quite right either, though...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Fiercely pushing one another, giving our absolute all in a clash of soulsâtrue victory is what's seized beyond thatââ

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That kind of triumph is what I call
VICTORY!!!! for real!
choice_data_list: (Winning is victory...?! Isn't that the same thing?!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wait, rookie that I am, here I was
spouting off like some big shot!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Tch, can't believe I slipped up like that!
ââMy bad, okay?!
Bamboo Memory dashed toward the exit like a frightened rabbit.
